content.title: Getting to the Dolby Theatre | Broadway in Hollywood
content.text: Skip to content Accessibility Buy Tickets Search Search Events or Keywords Search Getting to the Dolby Theatre Dolby Theatre 6801 Hollywood Blvd. (enter Hollywood & Highland parking structure from Highland Ave. or Orange Dr.) Los Angeles, CA 90028 CLICK HERE TO VIEW GOOGLE MAPS Traffic Alerts Don't Miss Your Curtain Due to Traffic Check your travel route prior to departing for the theatre! We recommend using these sites to provide up to date traffic conditions within and around Hollywood, and along the Interstates for those travelling from afar: ONLY IN HOLLYWOOD WAZE | Download the App Here SIG ALERT From Downtown: Take the Hollywood (101) Freeway Northbound, and take exit 9b toward Hollywood Bowl. Take Odin Street to Highland Avenue and travel South towards Hollywood Boulevard. From San Fernando Valley: Take the Hollywood (101) Freeway Southbound, and use the right 2 lanes to take exit 9C toward Highland Ave/Hollywood Bowl. Travel South on Highland Avenue towards Hollywood Boulevard. From the Westside: Take either Sunset Boulevard or Santa Monica Boulevard east to Highland Avenue. Proceed two blocks north on Highland Avenue to Hollywood Boulevard. By Public Transportation Take Metrolink to L.A. Union Station and transfer for free to the Metro Red Line. Exit at Hollywood & Highland. Metrolink tickets can be purchased via the Metrolink App or at Ticket Vending Machines and include free transfers to Metro rail. The app sells all Metrolink ticket types and provides the quickest and easiest way to get onboard. View PreviousView NextCancelClose
